body:
Investigation found a real, decisive root cause: apps2/mud's p.inventory is never persisted to or loaded from IDUNA on either connection path -- headless sessions (what the Auction House exclusively uses) idle-evict after 10 minutes with zero durability. Confirmed live via a real telnet kill (mutation logic correct, durability is the gap). Wrote docs2/INVENTORY_PERSISTENCE_NORTHSTAR.md, real 2-phase plan. Founder decided: scope it, don't build now. GFD commit 7ae18b0. Real sub-tasks logged to BACKLOG under SECTION for pickup.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-AH-93944: real root cause found and scoped (inventory persistence, not an AH bug)
